interpretation.high_freq_noise: The adaptive SSS cutoff captures the target low-frequency energy mass and leaves a measurable high-frequency residual for controlled ablation.
interpretation.sss_vs_simpler: Low overlap between SSS-selected tokens and simpler smoothers indicates that frequency-aware filtering is not equivalent to local pooling, Gaussian blur, or an additive uniform prior. End-to-end ablations determine whether the distinct ranking is beneficial.
